title: Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act 2019
summary: Higher penalties and mechanisms for electronic monitoring, recalls, Good Samaritans and a National Road Safety Board framework.
evidence: A March 2020 parliamentary answer said the Ministry had not conducted a specific impact study. One local autopsy-based study cannot establish a national causal effect.

title: Road engineering & safety programmes
summary: The National Road Safety Policy and MoRTH programmes address safer infrastructure, audits, black-spot treatment, vehicle standards and emergency response.
evidence: Programme existence does not demonstrate reduced deaths. Follow completed treatments with safety audits and outcome evaluation.

title: eChallan & enforcement
summary: Electronic enforcement and payment systems support implementation across traffic rules.
evidence: Challans are an activity measure. Pair them with speeds, helmet and belt use, injuries, fatalities and exposure to evaluate safety.
